· STUDENT ACCOMMODATION ONLY · AVAILABLE TO A GROUP OF FOUR FROM 30TH JULY 2024 AT £125 PER PERSON PER WEEK

A modernised upper maisonette in a good decorative order located on Glenthorn Road, Jesmond. The property has four double bedrooms, spacious reception/dining room, laminate flooring , wooden blinds, two tiled bathrooms with showers The property also benefits from being double glazed, has an alarm, kitchen with washing machine, tumble dryer, dishwasher, fridge/freezers and gas central heating.
